Target: NVIDIA (NVDA). NVIDIA designs accelerated computing platforms, GPUs and related software used in data centers, AI, graphics and gaming.

Focal announcement: NVIDIA Sets Conference Call for First-Quarter Financial Results.

Decision cutoff: 2026-04-29T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: NVIDIA Sets Conference Call for First-Quarter Financial Results. Published: 2026-04-29. URL: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-first-quarter-financial-results-6919947.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: NVIDIA will host a conference call on Wednesday, May 20, at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) to discuss its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended April 26, 2026. The company’s prepared remarks will be followed by a Q&A session, which will be limited to questions from financial analysts and institutional investors. Ahead of the call, NVIDIA will provide written commentary on its first-quarter results from Colette Kress, the company's executive vice president and chief financial officer. This material will be posted to investor.nvidia.com immediately after the company’s results are publicly announced at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT. The webcast will be recorded and available for replay until the company’s conference call to discuss financial results for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was only slightly favored. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.
